_comment: GW-ARCH-001 section 6.3. CORRECTED against a live Blender 5.2 headless inspection of all three supplied GLBs (see ../blender-inspection-report.json). The previous revision guessed source bone names; these are measured. Joint names are CASE-SENSITIVE.

clipsToDrop.pee_legLift: Out of scope. Section 1.2 restricts content to kind companion play; elimination behaviour is not in the section 6.3 clip table.
clipsToDrop.eat: Not in the section 6.3 clip table. Section 1.2 excludes hunger mechanics.
clipsToDrop.eating: Duplicate of 'eat'. Not in the clip table.
clipsToDrop.drink: Not in the section 6.3 clip table.
clipsToDrop.drinking: Duplicate of 'drink'. Not in the clip table.

requiredTransforms: DELETE the stray 'Icosphere' (80 tris, 42 verts, unskinned) present in all three files — a Tripo bounding proxy. It alone inflates reported bounds to 2.0 m.
Strip ALL scale curves. Section 6.3: 'Scale curves are forbidden.'
BAKE OUT ROOT MOTION: every clip translates 'hips'. Section 6.3 requires in-place locomotion; the motion controller owns translation and yaw.
RE-SKIN: max influences per vertex is 1 (rigid binding). Section 6.2 permits up to 4. Smooth weights are required or joints will crease.
Subdivide 'spine' into spine_01 + spine_02 and redistribute weights.
Insert clavicle_l/r and hock_l/r; rebind affected vertices.
Force root transform to identity within 1e-4.
Disable root rotation on turn_l_90 / turn_r_90 at import.
Resample to <= 30 fps after key reduction.

synthesizedBones.root: Zero-transform parent above pelvis. Source rig roots at 'hips'; the deterministic motion controller must own translation/yaw separately from the skeleton.
synthesizedBones.spine_02: Source has a SINGLE 'spine' bone. Must be subdivided into spine_01 + spine_02, with skin weights redistributed.
synthesizedBones.clavicle_l: No shoulder/clavicle bone exists in the source rig. Must be inserted between chest and upper_front_l.
synthesizedBones.hock_l: No hock bone exists. Rear leg is upper->lower->paw only. A hock must be inserted between lower_rear_l and paw_rear_l for correct digitigrade motion.
